messages:
Sasha M: Quick heads-up — planning a microburst deployment for inference routing changes today at 19:00 UTC.
Sasha M: Rollout plan: 3% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% over ~75 minutes, pausing 10m between phases to validate metrics.
Dmitri P: I can own the first smoke checks (19:05-19:20). Will watch p50/p95, error-rate, and inference QPS.
Elaine R: I’ll take phase 2 validation (10%->40%). I have the dashboard pinned and can run targeted prompts.
Priya K: Kevin, can you confirm model fallback is wired for the new routing? small e2e test please.
Kevin L: Confirmed — fallback path tested in staging. I’ll run a quick runbook smoke sequence right after phase 2.
Priya K: Also adding rollout gating: if 5xxs > 0.5% or latency p95 regress > 200ms we stop and rollback.
Sasha M: Rollback command if needed (ops):
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference --to-revision=stable-2026-03-17
``` 
Sasha M: @deploy-bot will start the phased traffic shift. oncall-sre, please standby for alerts.
deploy-bot: automated-checks: preflight passed, capacity margins OK, proceeding on Sasha M go-ahead.
oncall-sre: standing by. Pager duty is oncall-sre (Priya K) for the next 3 hours. Ping me directly if noise spikes.
Dmitri P: Quick Q — cohort selection: start with 3% in APAC east (low-latency), then roll to NA-west/NA-east. Elaine, agree?
Elaine R: Yep, APAC east -> NA-west -> NA-east. Avoid EU until post-40% to respect data residency routing.
Priya K: I'll keep a checkpoint doc in the release channel with timestamps and metric snapshots.
Kevin L: Leaving a quick smoke script here for repro (run from devbox):
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt='sanity-check: latency')
assert resp.latency < 600
``` 
Sasha M: If anything looks off, call rollback and add short note in the thread. No long analysis during immediate ops.
Dmitri P: @Elaine R can you mark the rollout steps as approved once you finish phase 2 checks? :thumbsup:
Elaine R: Will do. Target timeline: start 19:00, phase 1 complete by 19:10, phase 2 by 19:30, full by 20:15.
Sasha M: thanks all — I’ll post minute-by-minute check-ins in this thread. GLHF :rocket:
Priya K: +1 — I'll capture metric diffs and notify product if any user-visible regressions.
Kevin L: After full 100% smoke, schedule a 30m retrospective if anything needed to adjust rollout tuning.
Sasha M: End of preflight. See you at 19:00.
